purpose: Provenance for the prompt-factorial grid: the first run in this artifact that exercises the prompt axis.
relation: grid_v6 and grid_v7 exercise 3 seeds at 1 prompt; this grid exercises 3 prompts at 1 seed. Neither exercises both axes, which is why the seed and prompt numbers must not be read off the same table.

code_identity.gap: The stage-entry capture wrote 'no-git' and env_pin.git_sha is 'unknown': git inside the container refuses the repository because the mount is owned by uid 1001 while the container runs as uid 1000 (dubious ownership). The commit was verified host-side from the clone, so the identity is known, but the loop did not capture it itself. run_grid_extra.sh carries the same gap.

champsim.binary_note: Three designs, three distinct delivered binaries, none equal to the image default 688278205d6c9fa4.

traces.source: DPC-4 collection, re-verified on the host after upload

candidates.generator: gemini-2.5-flash via Vertex AI in the funded project, temperature 0.9, maxOutputTokens 16000
candidates.prompt_contract: shared MODULE_SPEC, differing design brief (see scripts/real_candidate_generate.py PROMPTS)
candidates.compile_rate_denominator: all generated candidates, per PRECOMPUTE.md gate 2
candidates.selected_cells: 3 prompts x 1 seed, the largest complete rectangle the compiled set supports

results.prompt_spread_definition: (max - min) / mean across prompts within the same seed and trace
results.per_trace_spread_definition: (max - min) / min, shown to make the ranking claim legible; the scorecard metric uses mean

gate_correction.why_that_was_wrong: The grid has one seed. _cv and _relative_spread return 0.0 for fewer than two values, so cross-seed CV reported 0.0000% and satisfied the <5% gate on an axis that was never varied. The gate passed on a vacuous metric.
gate_correction.fix: audit_repro now counts axis levels and treats an axis with fewer than two levels as unexercised: it cannot satisfy the gate, and publish_blockers records axis_not_exercised. Locked by test_single_level_axis_cannot_pass_the_gate.
gate_correction.regression_check: grid_v6 and grid_v7_gcp rescore to the same NON-REPRODUCIBLE / BLOCKED verdict they printed, with unexercised_axes now correctly listing prompt.

valid_claims_from_this_grid: Prompt choice moves the measured cycle count by (max-min)/mean = 249.18%, driven almost entirely by ligra_BFSCC where the spread over the minimum is 1607%. Ranking across traces is unstable (top-1 0.667, tau 0.556). Nothing in this grid speaks to seed variance.
not_yet_done: No grid in this artifact exercises the seed and prompt axes simultaneously. The compiled set supports a seeds{1,3} x prompts{aggressive_offset, fill_only_conservative} rectangle that would.
